question_text:
Passage: The Philippine Digital Governance Transformation Strategy (DGTS) 2022-2027 aims to streamline government services through digitalization. It mandates the integration of all government agency systems into a single digital platform, the Philippine Government Portal. The strategy prioritizes citizen-centric services, data privacy, and interoperability among agencies. It also requires agencies to adopt cloud-based solutions and implement cybersecurity measures. The DGTS is overseen by the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT), which provides technical assistance and monitors compliance. Local government units (LGUs) are encouraged to align their digital initiatives with the national strategy to ensure seamless service delivery.

Question: In the context of the passage, the word 'interoperability' most nearly means:

options.text: The ability of different systems to work together and exchange data
The security of data against unauthorized access
The centralization of all government services under one agency
The adoption of cloud-based solutions by all agencies
